verdict.rationale: Gemini is itself the built-in AI assistant. First-party docs show real task delegation: multi-step Deep Research across Search, Gmail and Drive; scheduled recurring actions; taking actions and editing content in connected apps (Calendar events, Gmail, Maps, Flights); and custom Gems built around user goals. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agentic delegation features (community items address model quality rather than these task-delegation flows), and connected apps are unavailable in Google Messages.
